issue: 2020 covers print 2 hours; syllabus and later papers print 2 h 15 min.
handling: Retain 2020 as first-examination content evidence; use the approved syllabus for current duration.

issue: Paper 2 total row prints analysis 23, although its part rows give 4+2 per question and five questions.
handling: Preserve the printed typo; the part rows and syllabus give analysis 30/100, not 23.

issue: Question says employers; report guidance and marks discuss employees.
handling: Retain the part and tariff but leave confident objective mapping empty; candidate employee-protection mapping is explicitly provisional.

sources: QP-2023-P2 PDF p.2 and Q3(b) p.8
issue: Case table labels the first year 2019; the question and report comparison call it 2020.
handling: Do not silently change the source year; use original coherent data in learner tasks.

issue: Hygiene-factor paragraph first says the factors do not themselves motivate, then includes contradictory motivating phrasing.
handling: Treat as a guide defect; do not copy it into a teaching claim. Keep hygiene/maintenance and motivators distinct.

issue: Some displayed ratio results/accepted values use truncation or wider tolerance: 24/36 and 12/18 are shown as 0.66; 16/18 as 0.88; 157/303 accepts 0.51 or 0.52.
handling: Recompute: 0.67, 0.89 and 0.52 to two decimals under Annexe A. Do not propagate truncation into new worked examples.

issue: Application commentary varies: earlier reports reject merely repeating company/product names, while later reports discuss distinct case details and guide examples sometimes credit named contextual references.
handling: Teach a relevant case fact linked to a consequence and use distinct details; avoid promising that a name alone always earns or never earns credit.

issue: Time-rate task includes wording about task completion within a time period; the guide has a per-unit-of-work phrase under time rate.
handling: Preserve the intended worker-motivation demand, flag ambiguous wording and use unambiguous payment definitions in new tasks.

issue: The 2022 guide separates avoidance from resolution methods more narrowly than the syllabus and other report examples.
handling: Do not turn one guide’s contextual rejection into a universal claim that negotiation can never resolve conflict.

issue: Specialisation/division of labour is accepted as a productivity factor in 2024 but rejected among responses in the specific 2023 task.
handling: Keep acceptance/rejection attached to its question context; do not blacklist a generally in-scope causal relationship.

issue: Topic 2.4 places inventory turnover in a liquidity list, while Annexe A groups it under efficiency.
handling: Keep both source descriptions and use the ratio’s actual numerator, denominator and interpretation rather than forcing a false classification.

issue: Worker-participation knowledge narrative appears to describe more components than its stated 4-mark subtotal.
handling: Use the 12-mark allocation and demand shape; do not copy inconsistent component arithmetic into marking guidance.
